description: Edit an unpublished post: caption, scheduled time, type, music, place, tags, stickers or framing. Pass at least one field; others unchanged. Published or publishing posts cannot be edited. (Requires INSSIST PRO.)

at.description: New publish time for an already scheduled post, ISO 8601, must be future; no offset = browser's time zone. To schedule a draft for the first time use draft_schedule.

caption.description: New caption, replaces the old one. Empty string clears it.

closeFriends.description: Story only: share with Close Friends instead of everyone.

collaborators.description: Usernames to invite as collaborators (co-authors), without @, replacing the current ones. Up to 5. Empty array removes them all.

draftId.description: Post id from draft_create or draft_list.

instance.description: Optional. Browser instance id from account_info; defaults to the active one.

linkSticker.description: Story only: link sticker layout, fields as in `sticker` except align. Default y 0.85.

linkText.description: Story only: link sticker label, up to 60 chars. Default: the URL's domain.

linkUrl.description: Story only: http(s) URL for a link sticker.

location.description: Place name to tag; first Instagram match wins, see `location` in the result. Empty string removes the place.

locationSticker.description: Story only: location sticker layout, fields as in `sticker` except align. Default y 0.15.

mentions.description: Usernames to tag in the photo, without @, replacing the current tags. Empty array removes them all.

musicTrackId.description: Track id from music_search to attach. Empty string removes the track.

musicTrackName.description: Track title from music_search, shown as label. Optional, goes with musicTrackId.

shareToFeed.description: Reel only: also show it in the feed. Default true.

sticker.description: Story only: text sticker layout, all fields optional. x, y = its centre as 0-1 of frame width/height from top-left (default 0.5, 0.6); scale 0.3-1.7 (default 0.75); rotation in degrees clockwise; variant default|white|solid|black|rainbow|black-text|white-text|sunset|ocean|neon-green|pastel-pink|elegant|typewriter|inssist; align left|center|right. May shift to stay inside the frame; see `stickers` in the result.

stretchToFill.description: true fills the frame (crops letterbox), false letterboxes. Omit to leave framing as is.

type.description: Change how it publishes: post, reel or story.

name: draft_update
title: Draft update
